messages:
Maya: Heads-up — I drafted a mini-canary matrix for the ACME cutover. High level:
- 1% tenant slice (5m)
- 5% regional (15m)
- 25% regional (30m)
- 100% global
Gate: latency p95 <= baseline+20ms AND 5xx rate < 0.5% over window.
Fallback: instant traffic-migration to model:v1-quant via flag 'acme_fallback_v1' and region pin to eu-west-1.
Also propose A/B run for 2% of users (treatment = model:v2 with quant) for quality check.

Omar: FWIW product acceptance criteria:
- Latency: p95 degrade <=20ms
- Errors: no >1min spikes >1% 5xx
- Quality: auto-eval prompts within 2% BLEU/metric
Need ACME legal sign-off on data retention for eval samples. :thinking_face:

Lucy: Ops notes:
- Pre-warm 10 instances in eu-west-1 10m before 5% step.
- Autoscale policy bump to +30% capacity for canary.
- Kill switch: if 5xx >0.5% across 3m OR p95 > baseline+100ms -> immediate rollback.
- We'll add a synthetic traffic probe and shadow path to catch regressions.

Tariq: From Customer Success — ACME wants opt-in flag for beta, and an explicit rollback notification window (30m SLA) + post-cutover debrief. They also asked for IP allowlist and dedicated billing bucket.

Maya: Notes on A/B: keep treatment names stable: acme_ab_t1 (v2-quant), control acme_ab_c1 (v1). Eval harness must run nightly diffs and flag auto-disable if semantic drift > threshold. :thumbsup:

DevExBot: @channel Canary plan added to /canaries with id canary-1745556666. Reminder: create feature-flag 'acme_cutover_v1' and 'acme_ab_t1'.

Omar: Next steps:
- Product to finalize acceptance tests by EOD Thu
- Ops to validate pre-warm & probe scripts
- CS to get sign-off + contract update
Let's sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. /cc @Lucy @Tariq

Lucy: ACK. I'll drop the probe config in the runbook (snippet below):
```
probe:
  path: /health
  qps: 5
  timeout: 2s
  alert_if_failures: 3
```

Maya: Thanks — will update the roadmap ticket and send ACME the cutover window proposal.
